title: OpenAI Uses 800,000 Messages to Expose Professional Boundaries: 43.5% of Work Inquiries Have Crossed Their Own Desks
excerpt: OpenAI has brought the idea that 'AI is breaking down the walls between jobs' to quantifiable data for the first time. It examined over 800,000 ChatGPT messages
content_html:
OpenAI has brought the idea that 'AI is breaking down the walls between jobs' to quantifiable data for the first time. It examined over 800,000 ChatGPT messages related to work and found a startling statistic: 43.5% of job-specific queries actually point to tasks from another profession. The company calls this phenomenon "task cross-pollination"—people are no longer limited to what's on their title, but are using AI to step into the territory of other roles.

Tasks in marketing and engineering are the most frequently overlapping, like two threads that are often intertwined. Users are now handling tasks that used to be handed off to experts: reviewing contracts, analyzing data, and troubleshooting website issues—work that was once tied to legal, analyst, or operations roles—is now being handled by one person with a chatbot.

This trend is especially strong in small companies. They often can't afford a dedicated team of experts, so non-professionals are more willing to use AI to fill roles like marketing—without a dedicated team to back them up, AI becomes an easily available substitute. OpenAI believes these usage patterns are an early signal before changes in job titles and descriptions occur, indicating that reorganization of roles is already happening, even if the organizational charts haven't caught up yet.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 首次将“人工智能正在打破工作之间的壁垒”这一理念转化为可量化的数据。 它检查了超过 800,000 条与工作相关的 ChatGPT 消息，并发现了令人震惊的统计数据：43.5% 的特定工作查询实际上指向其他职业的任务。 该公司将这种现象称为“任务异花授粉”——人们不再局限于自己的头衔，而是利用人工智能进入其他角色的领域。

营销和工程中的任务最常重叠，就像两条经常交织在一起的线索。 用户现在正在处理过去交给专家的任务：审查合同、分析数据和解决网站问题——曾经与法律、分析师或运营角色相关的工作——现在由一个拥有聊天机器人的人来处理。

这种趋势在小公司中尤其强烈。 他们往往买不起专门的专家团队，因此非专业人士更愿意使用人工智能来填补营销等职位——如果没有专门的团队支持，人工智能就会成为一种容易获得的替代品。 OpenAI 认为，这些使用模式是职位名称和描述发生变化之前的早期信号，表明角色重组已经发生，即使组织结构图尚未跟上。
